name: suicatap_wallet_sweep
description: SuicaTap Wallet Sweep — Scan all tokens in a wallet at once. Input: list of token addresses held by the wallet. Output: risk verdict for each token + overall portfolio risk summary. Supports Base, Ethereum, BSC. Cheaper than scanning one by one.

tokenAddresses.description: List of EVM token contract addresses held in the wallet (max 10)

walletLabel.description: Optional: wallet label or address for report header

jobInput: Sweep wallet 0x1234... and check all token holdings for risk on Base
